meta.name: apollo-core-workflow-b
meta.description:
Implement Apollo.io email sequences and outreach workflow.
Use when building automated email campaigns, creating sequences,
or managing outreach through Apollo.
Trigger with phrases like "apollo email sequence", "apollo outreach",
"apollo campaign", "apollo sequences", "apollo automated emails".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建 Apollo 邮件序列,自动化客户外联流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用 Apollo 批量发送外联邮件并管理跟进
copy.tagline_en: Build Apollo email sequences and automate outreach follow-ups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run email outreach and follow-up in Apollo

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会按 Apollo 邮件序列工作流操作:先检查前置条件(已完成线索搜索、Apollo 账号开启 Sequences、已连接邮箱),然后引导你列出序列与统计、创建新序列、添加联系人,并查看活动分析指标。
howto.when: 当你说出 “apollo email sequence”“apollo outreach”“apollo campaign” 等关键词,或要求用 Apollo 创建邮件序列/管理外联时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Apollo 里创建一个三步的邮箱序列。
say.note: 会按模板创建新序列并填入步骤。

say.text: 列出 Apollo 当前所有序列和各自的统计。
say.note: 会返回序列列表与关键指标。

say.text: 把这份联系人名单加进 Apollo 的“跟进”序列。
say.note: 会批量添加联系人并检查重复。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude follows the Apollo email-sequence workflow: checks prerequisites (lead search done, Sequences enabled, email connected), then guides you to list sequences with stats, create new sequences, add contacts, and view campaign analytics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like 'apollo email sequence', 'apollo outreach', or 'apollo campaign', or ask to build Apollo automated email campaigns / manage outreach.

say_en.text: Create a three-step email sequence for me in Apollo.
say_en.note: Creates a new sequence with steps.

say_en.text: List all current Apollo sequences and their stats.
say_en.note: Returns sequence list and key metrics.

say_en.text: Add this contact list to Apollo's 'Follow-up' sequence.
